achievement.1.description: 你對可疑的地方有敏銳的洞察力，喜歡閱讀別人的日記，尤其是那些有吸血鬼故事的日記。您也是一位專注的代幣收集者和探索者。尊重！
achievement.1.name: Castlemania
achievement.2.description: 啦啦啦……你現在已經熟記在自由灣所唱的邪教聖歌了。考慮到它主要由兩個音符和重複的歌詞組成，這並不難。
achievement.2.name: 詩班成員
achievement.3.name: 送乳工
achievement.4.description: 你一直都是個叛逆者──承認吧！供應囚犯、照顧被遺棄者、從富人那裡偷竊並施捨給窮人——不等等，那是另一回事了。
achievement.4.name: 抵抗萬歲
achievement.5.description: 簡單的火腿和麵包只會讓你開懷大笑。你是非凡的大師，融化起司、炸蝙蝠翅和搖晃奶昔。可口的！
achievement.5.name: 烹飪大師
achievement.6.description: 您在大貝殼中發現了一百顆美麗的珍珠。現在這條項鍊應該已經完成了——希望在這個過程中你的手指沒有被擠壓得太頻繁。
achievement.6.name: 尋找貝殼者
achievement.7.description: 如果有人在隨機的地方丟失了一件隨機的東西，即使您不知道什麼東西以及在哪裡，您可能是一個很好的人，可以詢問並去尋找它。
achievement.7.name: 背包旅遊
achievement.8.description: 你不關心別人按照你的喜好制定和塑造世界的規則。拋棄了毫無意義的習俗和道德，你只珍惜你所掌握的權力。你是命運的主人，並為淨化世界而戰。
achievement.8.name: 恐懼領主
achievement.9.description: 你證明了自己——不僅在你的夢想中——並且擁有堅強而精神的頭腦。你與惡魔和不死瘟疫的英勇戰鬥使你在夢魘騎士中獲得了最高和最受尊敬的地位。
achievement.9.name: Lord Protector
achievement.10.description: 你不是自我中心，而是沿著夢想和責任的道路前進。你沒有貪婪和自私，幫助別人而不求回報。
achievement.10.name: 惡夢騎士
achievement.11.description: 你已經加入了不死骸骨兄弟──讓死亡成為你的敵人，同時也成為你的武器。吞噬弱者並為強者留出空間是你的首要目標。
achievement.11.name: 骨頭兄弟
achievement.12.description: 你環遊世界進行了一次幾乎毫無意義的祈禱 - 但至少你不必再這樣做，並且可以在眨眼之間獲得新的受祝福的股份。
achievement.12.name: 有福了！
achievement.13.description: 你是一位才華橫溢的商人，能夠小心處理商品，找到好的報價並時不時地挖掘稀有物品。完成訂單永遠不會遲到，你是一個可靠的交易者 - 至少在拉希德眼中。
achievement.13.name: 認可交易商
achievement.14.description: 你找到了生命之泉並喝了一口。以為它不會給你永生，你感覺改變了，不知何故感到平靜。
achievement.14.name: 生命之泉
achievement.15.description: 你穿越了元素球體的超現實領域，召喚並殺死了元素之主，這一切都是為了取回中性物質。儘管您很勇敢，但如果沒有您的團隊，您就不可能做到這一點！
achievement.15.name: 元素之主
achievement.16.description: 你在海灘上重新演繹了《馴悍記》，並證明你可以很好地應對反复無常的女孩。有或沒有魚尾。
achievement.16.name: 海灘馴獸師
achievement.17.description: 當你做某事時，你就做對了。你有自己的觀點並且堅持它——否則沒有人能夠說服你。順便說一句，你有點殘酷和戰爭傾向，但這並不是一件壞事，不是嗎？
achievement.17.name: 阿澤魯斯的追隨者
achievement.18.description: 你是和平衛士，傾聽小人物的聲音。您已經下定決心並知道該幫助誰以及出於什麼原因 - 並且您將始終如一地這樣做。你們的戰爭是用理性而不是武器進行的。
achievement.18.name: 帕利穆斯的追隨者
achievement.19.description: 你會抓住每一個狩獵挑戰的機會，並以極其精確的方式執行這些任務。你本質上是個獵人，也是爪子與毛皮協會的重要成員。
achievement.19.name: 精英獵人
achievement.20.description: 你對狩獵任務很熟悉，而且已經完成了不少。身為爪子與毛皮協會的獵人，光明的職業生涯就在眼前！
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.21.description: 對你來說，一個吻不只是嘴唇的簡單接觸。你以無與倫比的感情親吻少女和遊手好閒的人，並透過女妖女王的親吻面對死亡和重生。幸運的是那些能夠與您分享如此親密時刻的人！
achievement.21.name: 熱情的接吻者
achievement.22.description: 你已經證明了自己是「家庭」中有價值的一員，並成功地為你的「叔叔」執行了無數間諜任務，以支持維諾瑞安商人及其目標。
achievement.22.name: 頂級AVIN代理
achievement.23.description: 少女力！無論您是否是女性，您都已經證明了對卡林女子旅的絕對忠誠和願意冒著生命危險。
achievement.23.name: 廣發銀行頂級代理商
achievement.24.description: 陰謀和公開的秘密是你的日常麵包。在面對敵人和完成間諜任務時，你透過勇氣展現了對泰國王室的忠誠。你是一名出色的 TBI 外勤特工。
achievement.24.name: 頂級 TBI 代理
achievement.25.description: 收拾好你的間諜裝備，準備好執行一些為秘密機構服務的危險任務。你已經表現出了你的意願 - 但你真的能做到嗎？時間會證明一切。
achievement.25.name: 特務
achievement.26.description: 你是一名有抱負的魔術師。在你眼中，科學和魔法配合得很好——儘管你在特拉斯工作時可能發出了無數錯誤的指控，但你現在可能已經有足夠的知識來建造你自己的魔像了。
achievement.26.name: 齒輪中的傀儡
achievement.27.description: 你已經背誦過很多遍的詩歌、詩句、歌曲和節奏。你已經通過了神秘的門，古老傳說的敘述者。即使是精靈也給你留下了深刻的印象，看來你真的很幸運。
achievement.27.name: 桂冠詩人
achievement.28.description: 您可以使用任何給您的樂器 - 並且實際上可以用它發出令人愉悅的聲音。在大多數酒館裡，您都是受歡迎的客人和藝人。
achievement.28.name: 吟遊詩人
achievement.29.description: 你對巴努塔瞭如指掌，擅長摧毀棺材和甕。巨大腳印的景像也不會阻止您探索未知區域。
achievement.29.name: 類人猿之友
achievement.30.description: 您的地圖是您的朋友 - 總是在您的後口袋裡，上面覆蓋著無數有趣且有用的地點的標記。有人可能會說，如果沒有它，你可能會迷失方向——但幸運的是，沒有辦法把它從你身邊帶走。
achievement.30.name: 領土
achievement.31.description: 事實證明，你是馬里德的寶貴盟友，加貝爾歡迎你隨時與哈倫和納鮑勃進行交易。雖然巨靈戰爭還沒結束，但只要你站在他們這邊，瑪里德就不會失敗。
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.32.description: 儘管火靈人只是不情願地歡迎你，並在相當長的一段時間內將你視為“只是一個人類”，但你還是成功地給馬洛留下了深刻的印象，並贏得了他的尊重並與綠精靈進行交易。
achievement.32.name: Efreet Ally
achievement.33.description: 夢想－是你的現實嗎？奇怪的景象、滴答作響的時鐘、上床睡覺並在完全不同的地方醒來——這確實是一次旅行，但你幾乎可以肯定你確實喜歡它。
achievement.33.name: 清醒夢者
achievement.34.description: 您去過大多數人甚至不知道名字的地方。收集植物、動物和靈質樣本是您的日常工作，您隨時準備發現新的視野。
achievement.34.name: 探險家
achievement.35.description: 即使是惡劣的水下環境也無法阻止您履行探險家協會的職責。偵察誇拉領域對你來說是小菜一碟。
achievement.35.name: 海上偵察兵
achievement.36.description: 哇——那是什麼？你不知道自己是如何來到這裡的，但不知怎的，你就是這麼做的。如何快速從貝雷加到達卡佐敦 - 這是那些矮人很想知道的事情，但你不太確定如何重現它。
achievement.36.name: 不可能的探路者
achievement.37.description: 溫暖、毛茸茸的、可愛的——雖然你剛剛擁抱的那隻熊如果有意識的話可能會把你撕成碎片，但他讓你想起那隻老泰迪熊，當你還小的時候，它總是睡在你的床上。
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.38.description: 你不是追捕它們，而是與它們交談。你知道鬼魂可能會保守那些在生者中早已失傳的秘密，你很擅長說服他們向你透露這些秘密。
achievement.38.name: Ghostwhisperer
achievement.39.description: 你對弱小的動物情有獨鍾，並且會盡一切努力保護它們——即使你早餐可能會吃龍。
achievement.39.name: 動物活動家
achievement.40.description: 你擁抱過熊，推過猛獁象，並證明了你的飲酒技巧。儘管你有輕微的宿醉，肋骨部分骨折，舌頭上有一些油膩的毛髮，但從現在開始你會很自豪地稱自己為榮譽野蠻人。
achievement.40.name: 名譽野蠻人
achievement.41.description: 您是在這裡提出問題的人，並且您知道如何獲得您想聽到的答案。此外，你還是一位著名的驅魔師，到處殺死一些吸血鬼和惡魔。您和您的股份是一個完美的團隊。
achievement.41.name: 高級調查官
achievement.42.description: 嘿嘿！打擊那些蠕蟲！你肯定知道如何使用大錘子。
achievement.42.name: 蠕蟲打擊者
achievement.43.description: 你不確定它是什麼，但你感到被皇室所吸引。你的膝蓋總是因為在王座前爬行而有點擦傷，而且你喜歡在城堡裡閒逛。也許你應該考慮申請當警衛？
achievement.43.name: 提比亞努斯國王範
achievement.44.description: 你跑得很快，擅長運送那些很快就會腐爛的貨物，即使你無法使用任何交通工具，或者你的手在這個過程中變冷或發臭。
achievement.44.name: 恰逢其時
achievement.45.description: 你喜歡跟別人開玩笑，讓他們看起來有點傻。喋喋不休地說，在受害者眼中意識到的時刻就是你賴以生存的獎勵，但你可能只是在開玩笑並與他們一起取樂......對嗎？
achievement.45.name: Perfect Fool
achievement.46.description: 有時，生活中最大的秘密可以有一個簡單的解決方案。
achievement.46.name: Mathemagician
achievement.47.description: 遞送信件和包裹一直是您的秘密愛好，現在您可以正式戴上藍帽子，吹響郵政號角，做您最喜歡做的事情。小心狗！
achievement.47.name: Archpostman
achievement.48.description: 你不相信浪漫是巧合，也不相信一見鍾情。事實上，愛情藥水、鮮花花束和俗氣的詩歌比以往任何時候都更能發揮作用。保持荷爾蒙流動！
achievement.48.name: Matchmaker
achievement.49.description: 你是亞美尼烏斯選擇真正向其展示真面目的少數提比安人之一 - 他讓你與他戰鬥。這要么意味著你非常幸運，要么非常不幸，但有一點是肯定的——這種情況極為罕見。
achievement.49.name: 他的真面目
achievement.50.description: 擁有鋒利犬齒的人最好小心你，尤其是在夜間，否則他們可能會在肋骨之間發現一根木樁。你是個無情的吸血鬼獵人，並收集了無數的代幣作為證據。
achievement.50.name: Razing!
achievement.51.description: 搶劫、邀請自己參加 VIP 派對、偽造合約以及冒充其他人 - 當涉及非法活動時，您就是萬事通。除了偶爾捕獲的金魚外，你不會俘虜任何囚犯。
achievement.51.name: 大盜
achievement.52.description: 你幫助把毛茛公主、啞巴博士和神奇狗幸運地帶入了生活——今晚可能會夢見他們，因為你完美地記住了台詞。多麼..特別的..劇本。
achievement.52.name: 業餘演員
achievement.53.description: 你在斯瓦格隆德的競技場上撲滅了火之靈的火焰。競技場戰鬥適合您 - 公平、公正、規則簡單、一對一的戰鬥。
achievement.53.name: Scrapper
achievement.54.description: 你在斯瓦格隆德競技場消滅了殘忍的奧喀斯。雖然你還很稚嫩，但仍有很大的潛力。
achievement.54.name: Greenhorn
achievement.55.description: 你在斯瓦格隆德的競技場中將觀察者送入湮滅，並在途中擊敗了其他九個危險的敵人。斯瓦隆德督軍萬歲！
achievement.55.name: 斯瓦隆德督軍
achievement.56.description: 你是勇敢的英雄之一，要面對並擊敗神秘的惡魔橡樹和它向你扔來的所有生物。揮舞你受祝福的斧頭，沒有一棵樹敢阻擋你——無論是惡魔還是惡魔。
achievement.56.name: Herbicide
achievement.57.description: 你勇敢地跳進了臭名昭著的殲滅者並倖存下來 - 贏得了名譽、榮耀和獎勵。
achievement.57.name: Annihilator
achievement.58.description: 你能夠在惡魔熔爐中的無數部落中殺出一條血路。你再一次證明了沒有什麼是不可能的。
achievement.58.name: 樞紐大師
achievement.59.description: 您是舞蹈界的領主或女士，並且不怕用您的技能給部落諸神留下深刻印象。左一步，右一跳，扭動大喊！
achievement.59.name: 才華洋溢的舞者
achievement.60.description: 你帶著完全無害的微笑，欺騙了所有有趣的人吃掉你的爆炸餅乾。下次玩這個惡作劇時，可以考慮穿上童子軍服裝，這樣效果會更好。
achievement.60.name: 允許 Cookie 嗎？
achievement.61.description: 你已經觸及了無情七人的所有王座並吸收了他們的一些邪惡靈魂。它可能永遠改變了你。
achievement.61.name: 無情
achievement.62.description: 您贏得了衝突島無情的 2 對 2 團隊錦標賽，並消滅了一波又一波可怕的對手。死亡或勝利——你當然選擇了後者。
achievement.62.name: 查佐萊冠軍
achievement.63.name: Wayfarer
achievement.64.description: 有一點是肯定的：您絕對喜歡游泳。和朋友一起在沙灘上閒逛，吃冰淇淋，打沙灘球，真是太有趣了！
achievement.64.name: Waverider
achievement.65.description: 音樂自然而然地來到你身邊。無論何時何地，你都感到很自在，並暗暗希望有一天你只靠演奏音樂就能擊敗敵人。繼續搖滾吧！
achievement.65.name: Rockstar
achievement.66.description: 在獲取金錢方面，你當然有你的辦法。其中許多是粉紅色的，上面鋪滿了碎瓷片。
achievement.66.name: 津貼徵收者
achievement.67.description: 微風拂過你的頭髮，你的手指抓著地毯的邊緣——這就是你喜歡的旅行方式。快點！更高！而且時不時循環一下。
achievement.67.name: 雄心勃勃
achievement.68.description: 您喜歡讓雙手又濕又髒，並且沾滿粘土。您完美的布羅格雕塑，憤怒的泰坦是您真正的傑作。
achievement.68.name: 黏土戰士
achievement.69.description: 你可能不再知道自己到底是什麼樣子——通常當你照鏡子時，某種怪物會盯著你看。另一方面——也許這是一個進步？
achievement.69.name: Masquerader
achievement.70.description: 海底 - 可能不是您自然的生活空間，但您在海底感覺很舒服。誇拉不再嚇到你了，有時你睡覺時還戴著深海頭盔。
achievement.70.name: 深海潛水員
achievement.71.description: 赤腳跑過餘燼不適合你！你用優雅的方式做到了。然而，總的來說，你有點被火和溫暖的環境所吸引——你喜歡熱！
achievement.71.name: Firewalker
achievement.72.description: 啊，大海的味道！站在岸邊拋線是您最喜歡的活動之一。對您來說，釣魚是一種放鬆，同時也能提供簡單的食物。完美的！
achievement.72.name: 來了，魚魚魚魚！
achievement.73.description: 如果有人給你種子，你通常會在幾天內長出一株美麗的植物。你喜歡你的房子綠色並裝飾著鮮花。也許您也與他們交談。
achievement.73.name: 綠拇指
achievement.74.description: 您當地的魔法商人認為您是他最好的客戶之一 - 您通常會購買大量藥劑，這樣您就不會在半夜醒來渴望更多。然而，你似乎總是很快就用完了它們。乾杯!
achievement.74.name: 藥水癮君子
achievement.75.description: 您喜歡在寒冷的環境中閒逛，並認為冰是最好的成型材料。當你可以用冰塊製作美麗的猛獁象雕像時，用冰塊來做飲料真是太浪費了！
achievement.75.name: 冰雕師
achievement.76.description: 您的家就是您的城堡 - 裡面的家具同樣重要。你的朋友在裝飾他們的房子時徵求你的建議，而你可能擁有那裡的每一個雕像、架子和床。
achievement.76.name: 室內裝潢師
achievement.77.description: 有時你會覺得那裡有個小妖怪。這麼多彩票，這麼多空白？這不公平！與世界分享你的痛苦。
achievement.77.name: 金克斯
achievement.78.description: 對一個人來說，這幾乎是太大的運氣了。如果某樣東西真的非常罕見——它可能遲早會落入你的懷抱。恭喜！
achievement.78.name: 幸運惡魔
achievement.79.description: 您是一位有抱負的大理石雕塑家，擁有前途無量的技能 - 您塑造的完美小蒂比亞蘇拉雕像就證明了這一點。有一天你會真正出名的！
achievement.79.name: Marblelous
achievement.80.description: 天哪，真是太棒了！你總是喜歡玩樂、交朋友、喝酒，並且喜歡成為人們關注的焦點。有無數值得慶祝的理由！嗚呼！
achievement.80.name: 派對動物
achievement.81.description: 您喜歡火箭起飛並爆炸成美麗色彩之前的那一刻 - 不僅僅是在新年前夕！
achievement.81.name: 天空中的煙火
achievement.82.description: 沒有……比騎在烏龜背上旅行更好的……方法了。至少你可以享受拉古納美麗的環境。
achievement.82.name: 像烏龜一樣快
achievement.83.description: 如果您看到生鏽的物品，您會忍不住將其拋光。您的庫存中總有一小瓶除鏽劑 - 誰知道，所有污垢下面可能有金色的盔甲！
achievement.83.name: 拋光機
achievement.84.description: 您可能一生中從未暈船過——您喜歡在海上度過空閒時間，並乘船行駛了相當長的距離。你不慶幸自己不用游泳嗎？
achievement.84.name: 船上的狗頭人
achievement.85.description: 搭乘矮人汽船穿越地下河是你穿越陸地的首選方式。船上沒有討厭的海鷗，還有好喝的啤酒！
achievement.85.name: Steampunked
achievement.86.description: 你不是完美、美妙、美麗嗎？走過鏡子時，你不能不欣賞自己的容貌。或是快速檢查牙齒上是否有東西卡住？
achievement.86.name: 虛榮
achievement.87.description: 算命師和占星術引導您度過一生。如果沒有您值得信賴的巫毒頭骨對您的批准，您可能不敢進行大型狩獵活動。
achievement.87.name: 迷信
achievement.88.description: 你為亞拉哈爾服務——但一路上你似乎不太確定該相信誰。阿澤魯斯和帕利姆斯的行為都有充分的理由，因此即使你幫助了他們中的任何一個，你最終還是遵循了你的直覺。祝雅拉哈爾繁榮昌盛！
achievement.88.name: Turncoat
achievement.89.description: 你們的蒂亞蘇拉小雕像在蒂比亞周圍非常有名，在大理石成型方面很少有人擁有類似的技能。
achievement.89.name: 大理石瘋狂
achievement.90.description: 雕刻狂暴的泰坦布羅格是你的秘密嗜好。蒂比亞周圍隨處可見無數完美的小黏土雕像，上面刻有你的名字。
achievement.90.name: 黏土成名
achievement.91.description: 拿一塊冰塊和一把黑曜石刀，你很可能會用它塑造出非常漂亮的東西。大多是可愛的小猛獁象，深受所有女孩的歡迎。
achievement.91.name: 冷如冰
achievement.92.description: 你喜歡魚——但最好是那些在寒冷的北方捕獲的魚。儘管很難找到它們，但您永遠不會厭倦在冰蓋上挖洞並將釣魚竿掛進去。
achievement.92.name: 品味精緻
achievement.93.description: 在跨種族理解方面，您是專家。你已經掌握了查科亞人的語言，並且讓某人對你的慷慨感到非常高興。阿丘克！
achievement.93.name: Jamjam
achievement.94.description: 你的世界很幸運有你！當勇敢的英雄被召喚來拯救世界時，您會毫不猶豫地加入並提供幫助。
achievement.94.name: 我盡了自己的一份力量
achievement.95.description: 在拯救世界或參加社交活動時，您處於第一線。無論你的做法是否引起人們的注意，你的世界都可以依靠你盡職盡責地盡自己的一份力量，讓世界變得對每個人來說都更美好。
achievement.95.name: 臭名昭著的世界拯救者
achievement.96.description: 你不認為自己太好了，不能做骯髒的工作，而其他人可能會因為殺死德沃沃爾加而贏得桂冠。沒有你他們做不到！
achievement.96.name: 團隊合作者
achievement.97.description: 你已經進入了德沃沃加的巢穴，並加入了隊伍，試圖將她打倒——成功與否並不重要，但他們不能責怪你不去嘗試！
achievement.97.name: 大膽的侵入者
achievement.98.description: 靈魂就像蝴蝶。渴望攻擊的活生生武器的黑色靈魂在你的腳下破碎。
achievement.98.name: 安莫斯拉殺手
achievement.99.description: 權力在於指揮它的她的意志。你全力以赴地與之抗爭——並且變得更加強大。
achievement.99.name: 奇卡頓殺手
achievement.100.description: 沒有什麼能比得上被困和撕裂的生物的狂怒了。你是值得尊敬的對手。
achievement.100.name: 伊拉薩的殺手
achievement.101.description: 盲目的仇恨以物質的形式出現，猛烈地反抗它與生俱來的不公義。你沒能伸張正義，但至少能暫時實現和平。
achievement.101.name: 佛洛多摩的殺手
achievement.102.description: 萬古禁忌的知識從來就沒有打算入侵這個世界。你在它的聲音被聽到之前就讓它安靜了。
achievement.102.name: 特內什帕殺手
achievement.103.description: 你幫助把德沃沃加危險的觸手和她巨大的繭放下來——沒有阻止她的轉變，但最終完成了導致她死亡的關鍵一步。
achievement.103.name: 厄運之繭
achievement.104.description: 眾多英雄中的一位特殊英雄。今年——是你。德沃沃加退出了一個更黑暗的領域，因為她無法承受你的力量 - 以及你的戰友的力量。時間會證明你所做的選擇是否正確 - 但現在，它拯救了你的世界。
achievement.104.name: Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: 累了……太累了……蜷縮在溫暖舒適的床上似乎是現在最好的事。好夢！
achievement.105.name: 桑德曼先生
achievement.106.description: 睡覺－你要做的很有風格。您在吊床上放鬆身心，聆聽鳥兒和蟋蟀的聲音，慢慢進入夢境。
achievement.106.name: 搖我入睡
achievement.107.description: 您不需要太多就能睡得舒適。一堆稻草和頭上的屋頂——後者是完全可選的——就足夠放鬆了。你甚至不介意老鼠啃你的腳趾。
achievement.107.name: 謙虛的客人
achievement.108.description: 嗯——那件禮物的內容並不完全是你所期望的。有這樣的朋友，誰還需要敵人？
achievement.108.name: 笑話是關於你的
achievement.109.description: 對於你的長著羽毛的小朋友來說就這麼多了！也許站在鳥籠前，捏住它的脖子，大喊「唱歌！」唱歌！唱歌！ '是不是有點太過分了？ ！
achievement.109.name: 哎呀
achievement.110.description: 你過著獵人和採集者的生活。嗯，尤其是一個採集者，尤其是採集大量藍莓的人。您最近檢查過舌頭的顏色嗎？
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: 濃稠、紅色——搖勻，不要攪拌——裡面有一根吸管：這就是你喜歡惡魔血的方式。配上洋蔥圈，微妙的金屬餘味幾乎不明顯。對健康或法力的有益影響是值得歡迎的。
achievement.111.name: 惡魔酒保
achievement.112.description: 你喜歡冬天。配備齊全的圍巾和手套，您喜歡在戶外與朋友一起堆雪人，享受樂趣。打雪仗，有人嗎？
achievement.112.name: 雪人
achievement.113.name: 野獸數量
achievement.114.description: 你和你的毛茸茸的毛絨玩具朋友形影不離，而且你並不羞於帶它們和你一起睡覺——誰知道你什麼時候會在半夜醒來，急需一個擁抱呢？
achievement.114.name: 我需要一個擁抱
achievement.115.description: 好吧，讓我們面對現實吧——只要你相信它可能會帶你找到有史以來最大的寶藏，你就不會放棄那張地圖，無論它看起來多麼可疑。這一切的背後一定有什麼秘密！
achievement.115.name: 機會渺茫
achievement.116.description: 要嘛你學得不快，要嘛你在自焚中找到了樂趣。或者您只是在尋找一個奇特的標題。無論如何，您應該知道，不建議在小驢子實驗中放氣。
achievement.116.name: 口袋裡的火箭
achievement.117.description: 但請閉上眼睛，不要告訴任何人你的願望，否則它不會實現！
achievement.117.name: 許個願
achievement.118.description: 聖誕節是你一年中最喜歡的時刻，孩子，你喜歡禮物嗎？為你的朋友買一些好東西，把它們藏起來，直到——好吧，直到你決定親自拆開它們。
achievement.118.name: 聖誕老人的小幫手
achievement.119.description: 有毒之子的憤怒－你無意中招致了它。你的日子已經不多了，你的死亡不可避免。有時候。某處。
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.120.description: 耶！勝者守門，敗者哭泣！誰在乎這些東西從哪裡來，以及你是否必須爬過垃圾堆才能得到它們？它是免費的！
achievement.120.name: 免費物品！
achievement.121.description: 上下、上下……然後就是大循環！等等 - 他們不會在 Kazordoon 中建立循環。但乘坐礦石車仍然很有趣！
achievement.121.name: Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: 先生或女士，您是一位真正的煉金術士。多年來，進行嬗變實驗以尋找每種可能的組合一直是您的秘密熱情，您的研究結果令人難以置信。感謝您，科學才取得了飛躍！
achievement.122.name: Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR！力量在你的身體中流動，你的心跳加速，腎上腺素為你的每一次武器揮動提供動力。全部裝在一個小瓶子裡。損壞的家具不予退款。如有更多問題，請諮詢您的治療師或藥水經銷商。
achievement.123.name: 狂戰士
achievement.124.description: 你覺得你可以在一分鐘左右的時間內解開最難的謎語。另外，你的法術傷害也會得到很好的提升。全部裝在一個小瓶子裡。後遺症－感覺有點愚蠢。如有更多問題，請諮詢您的治療師或藥水經銷商。
achievement.124.name: 策劃者
achievement.125.description: 提高視力，箭和弩箭以光速飛行，對敵人造成額外傷害。全部裝在一個小瓶子裡。不需要消耗胡蘿蔔。如有更多問題，請諮詢您的治療師或藥水經銷商。
achievement.125.name: Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: 呃！關上窗戶！擋住抬起醜陋的黃色頭顱的太陽，擋住鄰居肥胖孩子的震耳欲聾的笑聲。啊哈。擁抱甜蜜的黑暗和寂靜。
achievement.126.name: 請勿打擾
achievement.127.description: 崛起並閃耀！這是美好的新一天 - 打開窗戶，感受溫暖的陽光，看著鳥兒在窗台上歌唱，照顧你的植物。有什麼理由不高興呢？
achievement.127.name: 讓陽光進來
achievement.128.description: 啊！現在不要！為什麼這些多功能工具在你用它們來做一些完全微不足道的事情（例如榨汁）時永遠不會失敗，但當你迫切需要爬上繩子時，有一條噴火龍追著你，卻會搞砸？
achievement.128.name: 時機不佳
achievement.129.description: 你嘲笑被困在高高的草叢或燈芯草樹林裡毫無準備的冒險家。或者也許你確實幫助了他們。他們稱你為…「彎刀」。
achievement.129.name: 沒有什麼可以阻止我
achievement.130.description: 鐮刀在你的肩上揮舞，陽光照在你的背上——你本質上是個農民，熱愛在田野裡工作。或者也許你只是創造了奇特的麥田怪圈來嚇唬你的同胞。
achievement.130.name: 快樂農夫
achievement.131.description: 自由灣是您的完美去處，收割甘蔗是個非常輕鬆的休閒活動。親愛的，你想喝點加糖的茶嗎？
achievement.131.name: 天然甜味劑
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho 和一瓶蘭姆酒 - 當然是自製的，由手工採摘和親自收穫的甘蔗植物製成。現在，讓它在橡木桶中陳釀，大約10年即可享用。或者對於那些不耐煩的人：讓我們現在就來一場派對吧！
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: 沙漠沙丘下隱藏著寶藏 - 您有敏銳的嗅覺，可以找到它們，並且知道在哪裡挖掘。它們可能不會讓你變得非常富有，但無論如何它們都是閃亮而美麗的。
achievement.133.name: 淘金者
achievement.134.description: 你和你的鏟子——天作之合。或者地獄，就此而言。無論如何，在下面的某個地方。你會被石堆神奇地吸引，並喜歡打開它們，看看這些洞會帶你去哪裡。二頭肌也不錯。
achievement.134.name: 送葬者
achievement.135.description: 只要沿著餅乾屑的痕跡，任何人都可以輕鬆找到您。對你來說，真愛意味著放棄你最後一塊餅乾。
achievement.135.name: 餅乾怪獸
achievement.136.description: 任何提出相反說法的人都是騙子。
achievement.136.name: 蛋糕是真理
achievement.137.description: 著名的《融化的巧克力蛋糕頌》可能就是你寫的。度過一個下雨的下午，在煙囪前裹著毯子，盡情享受可可的美味，聽起來就像你會做的事情。享受！
achievement.137.name: 愛吃甜食
achievement.138.description: 您喜歡鬆軟的蛋糕，帶有水果味和美味的糖霜。而且你更喜歡自己做。你有沒有考慮過開一家麵包店？你現在一定已經很優秀了！
achievement.138.name: 上面有一顆櫻桃
achievement.139.description: 啊哈哈哈哈，這是…變異南瓜！在幫助把它拿下來之後——你確實幫忙了，不是嗎？ - 你領取了獎勵並得到了一份或多或少奇怪的禮物。萬聖節快樂！
achievement.139.name: Mutated Presents
achievement.140.description: 光之使者之一。那些幫助保持盆地燃燒並共同對抗黑暗的人之一。世界之間薄薄的面紗後面的惡魔低語——由於你的幫助，它們再次安靜下來。
achievement.140.name: 火焰守護者
achievement.141.description: 你是最忠誠的光使者之一 - 沒有你，惡魔肯定會撕裂世界之間的面紗。你點亮了每一個盆地，高高低低地移動，擊退了超凡脫俗的力量。要有光！
achievement.141.name: 真正的光使者
achievement.142.description: 你已經擊敗了蛇神的化身，並用蛇權杖的最後一擊，切斷了他的生命力供應。權力、欺騙和腐敗的故事已經結束了——或者……沒有？
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: 呃……你剛醒來身邊的那個人是誰？地板上有破碎的雞尾酒杯，房間裡滿是鮮花，你到底為什麼戴著戒指？昨天一定是漫長而奇怪的一天...
achievement.143.name: 後天
achievement.144.description: 長期關係不適合你。每次你以為自己戀愛了，很快就會被證明是錯的。或者也許你每次都遇到了錯誤的愛人——被剝削和背叛。保持單身可能會更好。
achievement.144.name: 恐懼承諾
achievement.145.description: 相信？愛？忠誠？呸！陳舊的情感。只要你玩得開心，你不介意踩很多顆心。最好穿著作戰靴。
achievement.145.name: 心碎者
achievement.146.description: 潛行殺戮和背刺是你的專長。你的眾多受害者通常沒有意識到他們即將死亡，而你卻默默地、迅速地將死亡帶給他們。一切都是被允許的。
achievement.146.name: 迅速死亡
achievement.147.description: 人生中最好的是什麼？粉碎你的敵人。看到他們在你前面行駛。之後也許可以喝杯好茶。
achievement.147.name: 粗暴的禮貌
achievement.148.description: 你是個乞丐，無家可歸，穿著骯髒、破爛的衣服。但這並不意味著你必須向任何人乞求東西——而且你仍然保持著你的驕傲。優良的羽毛不一定能造就出優良的鳥類──它們底下的東西比較重要。
achievement.148.name: 街頭生活
achievement.149.description: 戴著白骨兄弟會的徽章和深色長袍，你在這片土地上漫步，散播恐懼和痛苦，為即將崛起的死靈軍隊創造新的士兵。兄弟會萬歲。
achievement.149.name: 骷髏與骨頭
achievement.150.description: 你不害怕惡夢，你在惡夢中旅行——面對無數的恐怖，並與它們即將帶來的命運作鬥爭。很少有人相信你從夢中帶回的黑暗預言，但那些確實作為夢魘騎士與你並肩作戰的人。
achievement.150.name: 夢魘行者
achievement.151.description: 每個城市都應該自豪地稱像你這樣的人是它的居民。你負責保持街道清潔並幫助解決車站前的常見爭議。此外，您可能擁有一隻貓並且喜歡遠足。
achievement.151.name: 模範公民
achievement.152.description: 你攜帶那根木樁不僅僅是為了裝飾——你已經準備好使用它了。通常你會看到你在最深處的地牢中狂奔，留下被殺死的惡魔的痕跡。誰敢擋你的路，就該做好受死的準備。
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: 一份與自然，一份與野生動物。原始的獸性力量，敏銳的感官，在最高的懸崖上嚎叫，在最茂密的森林中咆哮——這就是你。
achievement.153.name: 狼與熊
achievement.154.description: 白天，你會發現你在樹林裡設置陷阱或追逐大型動物，晚上你坐在營火旁分享你的狩獵故事。你吃你打獵的東西，穿你剝的皮。生活可以永遠這樣繼續下去。
achievement.154.name: 時尚狩獵
achievement.155.description: 請記住：永遠不要嘗試教豬唱歌。這既浪費你的時間，又惹惱了豬。
achievement.155.name: 心裡傻瓜
achievement.156.description: 憑藉鋒利的刀刃並裝備堅固的全板甲，您可以以力量和勇氣向敵人衝鋒。總有一位少女需要為你拯救，一條龍需要為你殺死。
achievement.156.name: 身著銀甲閃閃
achievement.157.description: 您以沐浴在您的第一桶金中開始新的一天，並且您不介意穿著最好的衣服在街上漫步時炫耀您的財富 - 畢竟這是您辛苦賺來的錢！您更喜歡被稱為“殿下”。
achievement.157.name: 貴族
achievement.158.description: 雪堆和冰雹不能阻止你去你想去的地方。您已經做好了進入永久冰層探險的完美準備，並且知道如何保持雙腳溫暖。如果你是女性，這也是一項相當大的成就。
achievement.158.name: 暴風雪中外出
achievement.159.description: 在炎熱的沙漠陽光下，腳趾間有沙子，您會感到賓至如歸，而您最喜歡的旅行方式是飛毯。另外，你也許可以做頭部隔離舞蹈動作。
achievement.159.name: 一千零一
achievement.160.description: 你是一位幸運的紳士，在公海上戰鬥和狂歡，為戰利品和姑娘們服務！你不會對任何人或該死的君主政體負責，你的生活也不會是百合花。是的，夥計！
achievement.160.name: Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: 搖動撥浪鼓，隨著叢林鼓聲在火邊跳舞，聽起來像是您喜歡做的事情。此外，辮子是一種方便的髮型——無需梳理！
achievement.161.name: 薩滿之道
achievement.162.description: 你可能是鉅作《如何從地獄深處召喚終極野獸第一卷》的作者。或者，如果你的心清淨，你寧願召喚眾生來幫助別人。或者也許只是一隻小貓，供人擁抱。
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: 你不害怕在激烈的戰鬥中展現自己的本色。敵人害怕你致命的長槍和堅不可摧的盔甲。你贏得的戰爭清單令人印象深刻。歡呼並殺戮！
achievement.163.name: 戰爭大師
achievement.164.description: 勇氣是弱者的權利——無論你如何贏得戰鬥，只要你能取得勝利。厚重的盔甲只會阻礙你的行動，因此你要保持輕盈並依靠速度和技巧，而不是躲在不舒服的外殼裡。
achievement.164.name: Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: 你是一個謙虛的戰士，不需要財富或專門的裝備來旅行和戰鬥。你在藏王北部的土地上感到賓至如歸，並為打擊腐敗做出了自己的貢獻。
achievement.165.name: Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: 您為 Yalahar 所做的事通常具有深刻的洞察力和深思熟慮的行動。感謝您，亞拉哈爾可能有機會和平成長，並與快樂的人們生活在一起。
achievement.166.name: 智慧的雅拉哈里
achievement.167.description: 你用蠻力保衛雅拉哈，並準備好在必要時帶領它進行一場光榮的戰鬥。多虧了你，亞拉哈爾將變得強大到足以對抗任何敵人。
achievement.167.name: 亞拉哈里的力量
achievement.168.description: 在正確的時間選擇正確的蛋糕，生活就會變得如此輕鬆 - 而且您已經掌握了烘焙許多不同蛋糕的技巧，因此您應該為生活中遇到的幾乎所有事情做好準備。
achievement.168.name: 小菜一碟
achievement.169.description: 由於你在實驗魔法和咒語開發領域的開創性發現和成功研究，你被認為是埃德倫魔法學院的一流畢業生。有沒有考慮過教授世界末日咒語？
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.170.description: 你精通黑暗的魔法，通常會坐在蠟燭和頭骨的圓圈裡，嘀咕著難以言說的話。不要把東西搬得太遠，否則惡魔可能會來抓你。
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: 確實，你對兔子情有獨鍾。也許你今天救的兔子就是明天救你的兔子。當你真的很餓的時候。
achievement.171.name: 兔子滑倒了
achievement.172.description: 真正的科學家了解他們的設備。對於任何辛勤工作的研究人員來說，測試新發明都是必不可少的日常工作。你沒有表現出任何恐懼，拿著 Spectulus 和 Sinclair 的所有新裝備試了一下。
achievement.172.name: 天竺鼠
achievement.173.description: 你走進森林，遇到了羅丁·伍德和已婚男人，並在營地裡幫助他們擺脫困境。哦，不用擔心那些商人。他們不敢提及他們實際上擁有的、現在卻不知所蹤的巨額黃金。
achievement.173.name: 快樂冒險
achievement.174.description: 你通過了他們的測試，並幫助靈魂獵人測試設備、研究超自然現象和捕捉幽靈——他們會召喚你。
achievement.174.name: 就怕沒有鬼！
achievement.175.description: 幾乎所有你在藏王測試過的查坦植物都是不可食用的——你都嚐過了，但你仍然站著！不過，你現在真的應該呼吸點新鮮空氣了。
achievement.175.name: Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: 你勇敢地踏上了蛋糕島。世界上還有比這裡更美麗、更美味的地方嗎？
achievement.176.name: 蛋糕征服者
achievement.177.description: 你讓一個惡魔嬰兒高興起來，並將其送回了它的母親身邊。快速數一下手指就能知道你是否安然無恙。
achievement.177.name: 保母
achievement.178.description: 你讓一群惡魔嬰兒高興起來，並將他們送回了母親身邊。不要擔心燒傷痕跡，不要擔心白髮，不要擔心你尖叫著醒來的夜晚。這是值得的……也許……不知何故。
achievement.178.name: 來自地獄的保姆
achievement.179.description: 你已經與幽靈船長一起航行於幽冥海域。儘管危險重重，你和你的船員們還是勇敢地面對了挑戰。
achievement.179.name: 幽靈水手
achievement.180.description: 你曾多次與幽靈船長一起航行於幽冥海域。你已經熟悉了下界的危險，沒有經驗的旅行者向你尋求建議。
achievement.180.name: 幽靈旅行者
achievement.181.description: 你不畏死亡，不畏鬼魂，曾多次跟隨鬼船長旅行，是一位經驗豐富的幽冥行者。死者和生者懷著感激之情低聲談論你的功績。
achievement.181.name: 下界海盜
achievement.182.description: 你是幽冥海的高手，曾多次跟隨幽靈船長航行，對他的船和幽冥海的危險瞭如指掌。你笑對死亡，並可能在來世以幽靈海盜的身份回歸！
achievement.182.name: 死亡之災
achievement.183.description: 你幫助維持了女巫之火的燃燒。小心你的手指，很燙！
achievement.183.name: 打火機
achievement.184.description: 你犧牲了原料來釀造女巫的保護酒。
achievement.184.name: 女巫小幫手
achievement.185.description: 你犧牲了許多原料來釀造女巫的保護酒，並在擊退可怕的禍害者的努力中發揮了重要作用。缺點是即使是禍害使者也可能會注意到你...
achievement.185.name: Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: 為了讓女巫的火焰繼續燃燒，你丟掉了許多帶來禍害的木頭。有些人可能會發現你對火的迷戀......令人不安。
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: 你在反擊禍害使者方面所做的努力並沒有被忽視。你是女巫中的傳奇人物，你的名字充滿了敬畏和欽佩。
achievement.188.name: 名譽女巫
achievement.189.description: 噢，騎乘的樂趣！你剛剛擁有了你的第一個坐騎。非常方便的是，您甚至不需要馬厩，但可以隨時召喚它。
achievement.189.name: 天生的牛仔
achievement.190.description: 石頭總是讓你著迷。因此有機會在其中一個中找到真正珍貴的東西。根據統計，你現在應該已經發現了一些不錯的寶藏。但話又說回來，大多數統計數據都被「不幸之母」推翻。
achievement.190.name: Petrologist
achievement.191.description: 你已經發現了古人隱藏的力量 - 從現在開始，他們將在你的冒險中幫助你。
achievement.191.name: 隱藏的力量
achievement.192.description: 您一定知道如何讓您的家具和裝飾品發揮最好的效果。美麗的。
achievement.192.name: 我喜歡它 花式
achievement.193.description: 您总是随身携带黑曜石刀，并且会毫不犹豫地使用它。你剥过无数小动物和大动物的皮，是的：它们的内部通常不会变得更漂亮。這是相當血腥和血腥等等......
achievement.193.name: 膚淺的
achievement.194.description: 賭注吸血鬼和惡魔幾乎已經成為你的職業。你一定要收集哪怕是最少量的邪惡灰塵顆粒。謹防矽肺。
achievement.194.name: 灰燼歸塵
achievement.196.description: 別擔心，沒有人能夠從你手中奪走它。大概。
achievement.196.name: 安全存放
achievement.197.name: 裡面有東西
achievement.198.description: 噢。你自己的小金魚朋友 - 他很可愛，他很閃亮，如果你忘記餵他，他不會抱怨。他一定會為你帶來美好的一天！
achievement.198.name: 沉默的寵物
achievement.199.description: 在雪地裡跳躍、跳躍——這是最有趣的方式！匆忙地留下腳印－越快越好！整天舔著冰柱－冬天，永遠不會消失！
achievement.199.name: 雪兔
achievement.200.description: 邪惡的詛咒，邪惡的魔法－你不會迴避用可疑的手段來懲罰他人。有人剛剛用奇怪的眼神看了你──現在那根針又在哪裡了？
achievement.200.name: 黑暗巫毒牧師
achievement.201.description: 家是你目前最喜歡的狩獵場，儘管你可能比其他地方更珍惜某些地方，但你永遠不會有足夠的依戀感來真正在一個城市停留很長時間。收拾好你所有的東西——是時候繼續前進了。
achievement.201.name: 遊牧靈魂
achievement.202.description: 你向傑克解釋了真相，而斯佩圖勒斯在試圖說服他成為一個完全不同的人時犯了一個錯誤。
achievement.202.name: 說實話
achievement.203.description: 你沒有告訴傑克你和斯佩圖勒斯在試圖說服他成為一個完全不同的人時所犯的錯誤的真相。他將活在懷疑之中，直到他生命的終點。
achievement.203.name: 你不認識傑克
achievement.204.description: 神奇冬莓聯合協會特此表彰在年度秋季葡萄酒中持續無私奉獻和非凡努力的人們。
achievement.204.name: 漿果採摘者
achievement.205.description: 你和你的朋友三次向三位巫師表達了你的忠誠——我相信他們中至少有一個可能永遠感激你並為你感到無比自豪。
achievement.205.name: 真實色彩
achievement.206.description: 您已經掌握了所有可能形式的庫里克挑戰。
achievement.206.name: 變形大師
achievement.207.description: 在你友善的小幫手的幫助下，你吞下了 500 多塊史萊姆。幹得好，史萊默。
achievement.207.name: 更苗條
achievement.208.description: 你在藏王以南的塔樓裡殺死了狂怒的法師。再次。但這個人總是回來。維度傳送門再次崩潰，你知道他最終會回來，但是嘿 - 一個憤怒的法師，這就像自找的......
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: 您捕獲了 50 名罕見的閃光游泳者。把這些屍體丟進湖裡處理掉，真的很值得，不是嗎？等等，剛才水裡不是有東西在動嗎……？
achievement.209.name: Biodegradable
achievement.210.description: 你沒有調查它——至少沒有調查太久……但格羅姆做了。而你卻讓他鬆了一口氣。只是不要告訴他的朋友德朗克。
achievement.210.name: 深淵之眼
achievement.211.description: 許多深海生物都死於你之手。三百人已進入永恆的深處。你或許應該害怕深淵之眼的報復。
achievement.211.name: 深淵入侵者
achievement.212.description: 你撲滅了 500 場荊棘火！當Firestarters接管Shadowthorn時你就在場。你拯救了世界──也拯救了一些精靈的家園，儘管如此，他們還是會試圖殺死你。看到一切恢復如初，不是很高興嗎？
achievement.212.name: Firefighter
achievement.213.description: 你成功殺死了四百多隻白鹿 - 看起來你是它們很快被認為滅絕的主要原因之一，幹得好！
achievement.213.name: 獵鹿
achievement.214.description: 你現在是阿斯卡拉克的皇家大惡魔，王子殺手。
achievement.214.name: Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: 你現在是殺王子沙布拉克的公敵。
achievement.215.name: Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: 你打破了霍瑞斯提斯的罐子——五十次了。要嘛你不知道恐懼，要嘛乾脆忽略它。無論如何，你確實「無所畏懼」。
achievement.216.name: 無所畏懼
achievement.217.description: 有人打電話叫醫生嗎？您在危急時刻向韋諾貧民窟的奧託卡送去了 100 個藥袋，幹得好！
achievement.217.name: 醫生！醫生！
achievement.218.description: 當維諾爾受苦受難的公民面臨迫切需要時，您為他們提供了大力幫助。不知怎的，你仍然對發燒爆發的受害者感到親近。你的衣服使你成為他們中的一員，成為無數受苦受難者中的一個可憐的靈魂。
achievement.218.name: 喙醫生
achievement.219.description: 你戰勝了瘋狂的法師，你制服了狂怒的法師——沒有任何施法者能夠阻擋你。然而你自己卻非常專注於魔法研究。這種面料反映了個人對魔法藝術的認可。
achievement.219.name: 神秘織品魔法
achievement.221.description: 你已經打碎了血網的八條冰凍腿。正如他們所說：摔斷一條腿，然後再摔斷更多。
achievement.221.name: 蜘蛛噪音
achievement.222.description: 你已經深入了死亡之痛巢穴的沼澤深處，並且很快就解決了它。
achievement.222.name: 無根行為
achievement.223.description: 你已經殺死了埃斯梅拉達，這是變異老鼠中最醜陋、最具攻擊性的一種。沒有人會知道你在這個過程中差點失去一根手指。
achievement.223.name: 扭曲突變
achievement.224.description: 在艾瑟史萊克消失在稀薄的空氣中後，他的痛苦叫聲持續在你耳邊響了幾個小時。他可能轉移到了另一個存在位面……一段時間。
achievement.224.name: 美麗的痛苦
achievement.225.description: 今天一場大火被撲滅了。輪到火焰之子在永恆的生死輪迴中等待重生了。
achievement.225.name: 燒焦的火焰
achievement.226.description: 你把古老的聖甲蟲血肉爬行者撕碎了，並確保他沒有惹到你。
achievement.226.name: 爬行死亡
achievement.227.description: 你把戈爾戈活生生的捲髮打了個結，然後抓住了她的頭皮。你無法拯救她無數被嚇呆的受害者，但至少你沒有成為其中之一。
achievement.227.name: 蛇的新娘
achievement.228.description: 你發現了一位隱藏得很好的蜘蛛女王，並在她吃飯的時候讓她措手不及。
achievement.228.name: 不再隱藏
achievement.229.description: 看來通往冥界的大門還要暫時處於無人保護的狀態。強大的地獄獵犬科貝羅斯失去了頭。他們三個。
achievement.229.name: 地獄之門
achievement.230.description: 作為巨型海蛇利維坦的殺手，他的水下王國現在由你統治。
achievement.230.name: 淹死的海神
achievement.231.description: 肋步不再邁步了。不過他還有不少肋骨可以用。
achievement.231.name: 晚餐排骨
achievement.232.description: 在碎片死之前你差點就跟他成為朋友了。可憐的傢伙似乎只會以他冷漠的態度招來暴力。
achievement.232.name: 打破僵局
achievement.233.description: 碎石的頭比他丟給你的石頭軟得多。
achievement.233.name: 簡直把我氣壞了！
achievement.234.description: 你已經消滅了硫磺飛艇者的氣體雲，讓他洞穴裡的空氣好一點了……至少暫時是這樣。
achievement.234.name: 有什麼味道
achievement.235.description: 你用猛獁象血牙的獠牙刺穿了他。
achievement.235.name: 肉串
achievement.236.description: 「多數」已經不存在，但還有多少呢？人們永遠無法知道。
achievement.236.name: 少一
achievement.237.description: 你已經征服了劇毒之子和他的蛇心。
achievement.237.name: 嘶嘶聲的垮台
achievement.238.description: 老寡婦被你高超的狩獵技巧俘虜了。
achievement.238.name: 被她的毒液窒息
achievement.239.description: 你用鯛魚的深紅色血液污染了叢林地面。
achievement.239.name: 血紅素魚
achievement.240.description: 今天你已經砍掉了很多觸手。瑟爾被趕回了他所屬的地方。
achievement.240.name: 重回深淵
achievement.241.description: 你已經面對並擊敗了爪子和毛皮協會派你去殺的許多強大的首領。一切都靠你自己。真是一场狩猎啊！
achievement.241.name: 掉了很多毛皮
achievement.242.description: 你阻止了銀行搶匪並歸還了裝滿黃金的袋子。很高興知道周圍仍然有像你這樣守序的提比安人。
achievement.242.name: 誠實的發現者
achievement.243.description: 如果不是你，蒂比亞的幾家銀行現在早就破產了。繼續追捕銀行搶匪，沒人會擔心提比安的經濟！
achievement.243.name: 淘金者
achievement.244.description: 你發現了巨大的腳印和到處亂跑的受驚大象。難道神祕猿神正在叢林中漫步？
achievement.244.name: 猿神的蹤跡
achievement.245.description: 那不是一隻巨型蜘蛛。這裡有一些巫術在運作。
achievement.245.name: 有人無聊
achievement.246.description: 你不能保守秘密，不是嗎？話又說回來，你只是在履行身為合法公民對卡林女王的義務。這是一件好事，不是嗎……？
achievement.246.name: 檢舉人
achievement.247.description: 維達似乎真的非常非常無聊。你也發現她其實不需要冒險者帶給她的那些血藥草。儘管如此，她還是很友善地從你那裡拿走了一件，並給了你一些很酷的東西作為交換。
achievement.247.name: 撕裂的寶藏
achievement.248.description: 您參加了國王節慶祝活動並向提比阿努斯國王表示敬意。現在，去參加派對吧！
achievement.248.name: 忠誠的臣民
achievement.249.description: 您成功地在通常沒有水的環境中釣到了一條魚。一切都可能會改變，也許......
achievement.249.name: 沙漠漁夫
achievement.251.description: 你給麵條帶了回家的路。這次他要多久才能再逍遙法外？那隻狗現在在王座室一定很無聊了。
achievement.251.name: 狗狗保姆
achievement.252.description: 你目睹了斯瓦格隆德的解凍，並從一些奇怪的冰植物中收穫了稀有種子。他們一定對某件事有好處。
achievement.252.name: 冰收割機
achievement.253.description: 你是一個非常聰明的思想家，並且成功地創造了永生之花。它們可能會受到所有那些不擅長園藝或只是健忘的人的歡迎。
achievement.253.name: Preservationist
achievement.254.description: 你發現了三個遊牧營地並偷走了他們的補給品。好吧，你可能可以比他們更好地使用它們。
achievement.254.name: 寶箱強盜
achievement.255.description: 你在洪水氾濫的平原上發現了一個秘密地牢，並殺死了其中的幾名居民。現在你的腳濕了。
achievement.255.name: 落入下水道
achievement.256.description: 你在地獄峽谷噴發中倖存下來，並找到了穿越火焰和熔岩的出路。你甚至在路上殺了一些火種。
achievement.256.name: 來自地球的火
achievement.257.description: 你的行動開始產生影響力。你經常讓蜂巢的觸角失明，以至於成為它的煩惱。
achievement.257.name: 輕微幹擾
achievement.258.description: 在與蜂巢的戰爭中，你致盲蜂巢的努力開始得到回報。你的行為嚴重蒙蔽了蜂巢，而實體似乎意識到正在發生危險的事情。
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: 你投入了大量的時間和精力來讓蜂巢不知道 Quirefang 上正在發生的事情。蜂巢學會了害怕你的行為。如果它能找到你，它一定會全力碾壓你！
achievement.259.name: 蜂巢盲人
achievement.260.description: 你已經習慣了經常光顧蜂巢的胃系統。你的行為為蜂巢帶來了一些最初的消化問題。
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: 你不知疲倦地攻擊強大蜂巢的內部器官。你對蜂巢消化系統的攻擊開始造成一些麻煩。
achievement.261.name: 胃灼熱
achievement.262.description: 你嚴重擾亂了蜂巢的消化。蜂巢一定該去看醫生。看來你的能力已經超出它的承受能力了。
achievement.262.name: 胃潰瘍
achievement.263.description: 蜂巢必須全力以赴，阻礙其士兵只是第一步。你努力地堵塞了蜂巢的毛孔，以傳播它的戰士。
achievement.263.name: 播種機
achievement.264.description: 你在摧毀敵軍補給方面的經驗越來越豐富。你的行為給蜂巢帶來了一些嚴重的皮膚問題。
achievement.264.name: 疙瘩
achievement.265.description: 擁有最充足兵力的人才能贏得戰爭。你的行動給蜂巢的軍隊帶來了沉重的打擊。你持久而嚴重地中斷了蜂巢的部隊補給。
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: 透過殺死蜂巢中的生物並獲得武器來執行進一步的任務，你開始了一種非常有效的戰爭方式。你收集了大量溶解的甲殼素來補充戰爭物資。
achievement.266.name: 採集者
achievement.267.description: 補給的需求常常決定輸贏。你們為補給資源而不懈努力，讓針對蜂巢的戰爭繼續進行。
achievement.267.name: 供應商
achievement.268.description: 你已經變得有能力和有效率地收集對抗蜂巢所需的物質。你聞起來幾乎像是溶解的甲殼素，如果他們的孩子會說話，蜂巢出生者就會告訴他們關於你的可怕故事。
achievement.268.name: Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: 你已經證明了你可以擊敗蜂巢中的最強者。你已經在蜂巢的防禦中造成了第一個有希望的突破
achievement.269.name: 守衛殺手
achievement.270.description: 蜂巢中最強大的戰士都被你殺死了數十人。由於你的行為，蜂巢不再安全。
achievement.270.name: 蜂巢滲透者
achievement.271.description: 有效率且致命，你在與蜂巢精銳部隊的戰鬥中獲得了豐富的經驗。你幾乎單槍匹馬地殺死了最優秀的蜂巢誕生者並活了下來講述這個故事。
achievement.271.name: Exterminator
achievement.272.description: 即使在蜂巢的最深處，你也開始攻擊強大的敵人。你的舉動恐怕已經讓蜂巢頭痛了。
achievement.272.name: 頭痛
achievement.273.description: The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
achievement.273.name: Confusion
achievement.274.description: You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
achievement.274.name: Manic
achievement.276.name: Navigational Error
achievement.277.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
achievement.278.name: Guardian Downfall
achievement.279.description: You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
achievement.279.name: Death Song
achievement.280.description: By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
achievement.280.name: Depth Dwellers
achievement.281.description: You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
achievement.281.name: Gem Cutter
achievement.282.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
achievement.282.name: Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: Bane of the Hive
achievement.285.description: Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: Hive War Veteran
achievement.286.description: You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: Hive Fighter
achievement.287.description: You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
achievement.287.name: Howly Silence
achievement.288.description: No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: Dream's Over
achievement.289.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.290.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
achievement.290.name: Stepped on a Big Toe
achievement.291.description: No joke, you murdered the bat.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: Enter zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: King of the Ring
achievement.294.description: You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: Back from the Dead
achievement.295.description: You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: Pwned All Fur
achievement.297.description: You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: Bibby's Bloodbath
achievement.298.description: You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: Becoming a Bigfoot
achievement.300.description: You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: Gnome Little Helper
achievement.301.description: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: Gnome Friend
achievement.302.description: You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: Honorary Gnome
achievement.304.description: You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: Crystals in Love
achievement.305.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: Substitute Tinker
achievement.306.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: Grinding Again
achievement.308.description: Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: Dungeon Cleaner
achievement.309.description: So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: Crystal Keeper
achievement.310.description: Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: Call Me Sparky
achievement.311.description: One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: One Foot Vs. Many
achievement.312.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: The Picky Pig
achievement.313.description: You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: Diplomatic Immunity
achievement.314.description: Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: Fall of the Fallen
achievement.315.description: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
achievement.315.name: Death on Strike
achievement.316.description: The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: Death from Below
achievement.317.description: The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: Gnomebane's Bane
achievement.318.description: The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: Final Strike
achievement.319.description: Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: Goo Goo Dancer
achievement.320.description: Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: Gnomish Art Of War
achievement.324.description: You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: True Dedication
achievement.325.description: Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: Task Manager
achievement.326.description: Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
achievement.326.name: Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repenter
achievement.328.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: Umbral Swordsman
achievement.331.description: You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: Cave Completionist
achievement.332.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: Umbral Executioner
achievement.335.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: Umbral Archer
achievement.338.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: Umbral Harbinger
achievement.340.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: Umbral Master
achievement.341.description: You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: Luring Silence
achievement.343.description: You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: Never Surrender
achievement.344.description: You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: Dream Wright
achievement.345.description: You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: Ending the Horror
achievement.346.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: Dream Warden
achievement.348.description: Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: Prison Break
achievement.349.description: After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: Noblesse Obliterated
achievement.350.description: Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
achievement.350.name: Elementary, My Dear
achievement.351.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
achievement.351.name: Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
achievement.352.name: Rathleton Inhabitant
achievement.353.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
achievement.353.name: Rathleton Citizen
achievement.354.description: You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: Combo Master
achievement.355.description: Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
achievement.355.name: Glooth Engineer
achievement.356.description: You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
achievement.356.name: Lion's Den Explorer
achievement.357.description: Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
achievement.357.name: Seasoned Adventurer
achievement.358.description: You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
achievement.358.name: Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
achievement.359.name: Rathleton Squire
achievement.360.description: He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
achievement.360.name: The Professor's Nut
achievement.361.description: You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
achievement.361.name: Plant vs. Minos
achievement.362.description: You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
achievement.362.name: Rumble in the Plant
achievement.363.description: You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
achievement.363.name: Robo Chop
achievement.364.description: You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
achievement.364.name: Go with da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
achievement.365.name: Wail of the Banshee
achievement.366.description: You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
achievement.366.name: Publicity
achievement.367.description: By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: Snake Charmer
achievement.368.description: Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: Hoard of the Dragon
achievement.370.description: You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: Little Ball of Wool
achievement.371.description: You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: Luminous Kitty
achievement.372.description: By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: The Right Tone
achievement.373.description: Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Loyal Lad
achievement.374.description: It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: Dragon Mimicry
achievement.375.description: The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: Scales and Tail
achievement.376.description: There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: Fabled Construction
achievement.378.description: Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: Mind the Dog!
achievement.379.description: This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.380.description: Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: Golden Sands
achievement.381.description: Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: Friend of Elves
achievement.382.description: Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: Lovely Dots
achievement.383.description: This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: Way to Hell
achievement.384.description: Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: Beneath the Sea
achievement.385.description: By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: Starless Night
achievement.386.description: By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Lion King
achievement.387.description: Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: Pecking Order
achievement.388.description: Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
achievement.388.name: Pig-Headed
achievement.389.description: It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: Personal Nightmare
achievement.390.description: It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
achievement.390.name: Thick-Skinned
achievement.391.description: Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: Chequered Teddy
achievement.392.description: Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: Knock on Wood
achievement.395.description: This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: Fried Shrimp
achievement.396.description: What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: Out of the Stone Age
achievement.397.description: A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Gear Up
achievement.399.description: Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: Bearbaiting
achievement.400.description: 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
achievement.400.name: Lucky Horseshoe
achievement.401.description: By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
achievement.401.name: Swamp Beast
achievement.402.description: Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
achievement.402.name: Spin-Off
achievement.403.description: Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
achievement.403.name: Icy Glare
achievement.404.description: You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
achievement.404.name: Cartography 101
achievement.405.description: Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
achievement.405.name: Lost Palace Raider
achievement.406.description: It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
achievement.406.name: The More the Merrier
achievement.408.description: You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
achievement.408.name: Rift Warrior
achievement.410.description: You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
achievement.410.name: Hat Hunter
achievement.411.description: You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
achievement.411.name: Ogre Chef
achievement.412.description: You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
achievement.412.name: The Call of the Wild
achievement.413.description: You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
achievement.413.name: Ender of the End
achievement.414.description: After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
achievement.414.name: Vortex Tamer
achievement.415.description: Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
achievement.415.name: Rhino Rider
achievement.416.description: You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
achievement.416.name: Forbidden Fruit
achievement.417.description: Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
achievement.417.name: Forbidden Knowledge
achievement.418.description: You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
achievement.418.name: Treasure Hunter
achievement.419.description: You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
achievement.419.name: Reason to Celebrate
achievement.420.description: You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
achievement.420.name: Toothfairy Assistant
achievement.421.description: Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
achievement.421.name: Fairy Teasing
achievement.422.description: You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
achievement.422.name: Corruption Contained
achievement.430.description: You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.430.name: Little Adventure
achievement.431.description: You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.431.name: Little Big Adventure
achievement.432.description: You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.432.name: Contender
achievement.433.description: You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.433.name: Serious Contender
achievement.434.description: You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.434.name: Skilled Hunter
achievement.435.description: You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.435.name: Master Hunter
achievement.436.description: You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
achievement.436.name: Hunting Permit
achievement.437.description: The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
achievement.437.name: Over the Moon
achievement.438.description: You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.438.name: His Days are Counted
achievement.439.description: You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.439.name: Duked It Out
achievement.440.description: You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.440.name: Buried the Baron
achievement.441.description: The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
achievement.441.name: Death in the Depths
achievement.442.description: You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
achievement.442.name: Scourge of Scarabs
achievement.443.description: Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
achievement.443.name: Cobbled and Patched
achievement.444.description: Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
achievement.444.name: Up the Molehill
achievement.445.description: You truly are the grand master of verbal debate! Now going forth and putting this wisdom to good use in everyday life... is probably debatable.
achievement.445.name: Master Debater
achievement.446.description: You asked Captain Charles to take a shortcut quite a few times. Now you are all too familiar with desert islands all over Tibia.
achievement.446.name: High and Dry
achievement.447.description: Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
achievement.447.name: Elven Woods
achievement.448.description: Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
achievement.448.name: Long Live the Queen
achievement.449.description: Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
achievement.449.name: Stronghold of Edron
achievement.450.description: Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
achievement.450.name: Dwarven Mines
achievement.451.description: Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
achievement.451.name: All Hail the King
achievement.452.description: Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
achievement.452.name: Jewel in the Swamp
achievement.453.description: A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
achievement.453.name: The Ogre Steppe
achievement.454.description: Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
achievement.454.name: Realms of Dreams
achievement.455.description: You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
achievement.455.name: Mummy's Dearest
achievement.456.description: You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
achievement.456.name: Daraman's Footsteps
achievement.457.description: You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
achievement.457.name: King of the Jungle
achievement.458.description: You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
achievement.458.name: Ancient Splendor
achievement.459.description: A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
achievement.459.name: Liberty Bay Watch
achievement.460.description: You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
achievement.460.name: Race to the Pole
achievement.461.description: From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
achievement.461.name: Lizard Kingdom
achievement.462.description: Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
achievement.462.name: Trip to the Beach
achievement.463.description: Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
achievement.463.name: Glooth Punk
achievement.464.description: A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
achievement.464.name: Twisted Dreams
achievement.465.description: Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
achievement.465.name: Library Liberator
achievement.466.description: You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
achievement.466.name: Spectulation
achievement.467.description: You defeated Grand Master Oberon and the remnants of the Order of the Falcon, no matter the odds.
achievement.467.name: Millennial Falcon
achievement.468.description: You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
achievement.468.name: Bibliomaniac
achievement.469.description: Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
achievement.469.name: Battle Mage
achievement.470.description: As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
achievement.470.name: Widely Travelled
achievement.471.description: You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
achievement.471.name: Running the Rift
achievement.473.description: Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
achievement.473.name: Exalted Battle Mage
achievement.474.description: Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
achievement.474.name: Areas of Effect
achievement.475.description: You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
achievement.475.name: Tied the Knot
achievement.476.description: You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
achievement.476.name: Keeper of the 7 Keys
achievement.477.description: You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
achievement.477.name: Dream Warrior
achievement.478.description: Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
achievement.478.name: Moth Whisperer
achievement.479.description: You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
achievement.479.name: Lacewing Catcher
achievement.480.description: This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
achievement.480.name: No Horse Open Sleigh
achievement.481.description: But can you truly be one of them?
achievement.481.name: Raider in the Dark
achievement.482.description: You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
achievement.482.name: Dream Catcher
achievement.483.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Summer Court.
achievement.483.name: Champion of Summer
achievement.484.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Winter Court.
achievement.484.name: Champion of Winter
achievement.486.description: You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
achievement.486.name: Bewitcher
achievement.487.description: Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
achievement.487.name: Gryphon Rider
achievement.488.description: Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
achievement.488.name: Sculptor Apprentice
achievement.489.description: You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
achievement.489.name: Sun and Sea
achievement.490.description: You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
achievement.490.name: A Study in Scarlett
achievement.491.description: What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
achievement.491.name: Avid Spectral Reader
achievement.492.description: You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
achievement.492.name: Hippofoddermus
achievement.493.description: You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
achievement.493.name: Inquisition's Hand
achievement.494.description: Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
achievement.494.name: The Empire's Glory
achievement.495.description: Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated Hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
achievement.495.name: Inquisition's Arm
achievement.496.description: You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
achievement.496.name: Traditionalist
achievement.497.description: Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
achievement.497.name: Do a Barrel Roll!
achievement.499.description: The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
achievement.499.name: Orcsoberfest Welcome
achievement.500.description: You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
achievement.500.name: Prospectre
achievement.501.description: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
achievement.501.name: Nothing but Hot Air
achievement.502.name: Verminbane
achievement.503.description: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
achievement.503.name: Monsterhunter
achievement.504.description: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
achievement.504.name: Taskmaster
achievement.505.description: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
achievement.505.name: Mainstreet Nightmare
achievement.506.description: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
achievement.506.name: Falconer
achievement.507.description: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
achievement.507.name: Steppe Elegance
achievement.508.description: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
achievement.508.name: Beyonder
achievement.510.description: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
achievement.510.name: Drama in Darama
achievement.511.description: Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
achievement.511.name: Malefitz
achievement.512.description: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
achievement.512.name: Lionheart
achievement.513.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.513.name: Soul Mender
achievement.514.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.514.name: You Got Horse Power
achievement.515.description: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
achievement.515.name: Unleash the Beast
achievement.516.description: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
achievement.516.name: Well Roared, Lion!
achievement.518.description: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
achievement.518.name: Honorary Rascoohan
achievement.519.description: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
achievement.519.name: Release the Kraken
achievement.521.description: You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
achievement.521.name: Pied Piper
achievement.522.description: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
achievement.522.name: Woodcarver
achievement.523.description: Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
achievement.523.name: Bounacean Chivalry
achievement.524.description: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
achievement.524.name: Knowledge Raider
achievement.525.description: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
achievement.525.name: Citizen of Issavi
achievement.526.description: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
achievement.526.name: King's Council
achievement.527.description: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
achievement.527.name: Hot on the Trail
achievement.528.description: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
achievement.528.name: Shell We Take a Ride
achievement.529.description: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
achievement.529.name: Phantastic!
achievement.530.description: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
achievement.530.name: Some Like It Hot
achievement.531.description: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
achievement.531.name: First Achievement
achievement.532.description: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
achievement.532.name: Sharp Dressed
achievement.533.description: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
achievement.533.name: Engine Driver
achievement.534.description: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
achievement.534.name: Friendly Fire
achievement.535.description: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
achievement.535.name: Wedding Planner
achievement.536.description: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
achievement.536.name: Beaver Away
achievement.537.description: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
achievement.537.name: Snake Pit
achievement.538.description: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
achievement.538.name: Royalty of Hazard
achievement.539.description: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
achievement.539.name: Measuring the World
achievement.540.description: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your Ripptor.
achievement.540.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!
achievement.541.description: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
achievement.541.name: Warrior of the Iks
achievement.542.description: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
achievement.542.name: Mutagenius
achievement.543.description: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
achievement.543.name: Strangest Thing
achievement.544.description: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
achievement.544.name: Fully Decayed
achievement.545.description: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
achievement.545.name: Like Fox and Mouse
achievement.546.description: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
achievement.546.name: The Spirit of Purity
achievement.547.description: You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
achievement.547.name: Museum Goer
achievement.548.description: Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
achievement.548.name: Mystic Predator
achievement.549.description: You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
achievement.549.name: The Rule of Raccool
